title: Live below-profile H_phreatic reduction through qualified mode-5 Reference Richards
purpose: Test the source-declared below-profile mode-1 reduction without admitting bottom_mode=1: derive mode-5 hbot from a typed H_phreatic coordinate, then solve through the already qualified explicit Reference-Richards mode-5 route.
gates: All prescribed H_phreatic values are below the declared -300 cm bottom face.
The mapping to hbot is exact to floating-point arithmetic and H_phreatic is retained as a distinct research coordinate.
Every trial is reconstructed from the same immutable origin and solved with bottom_mode=5 through reference_richards_legacy_solver_t.
Every solve converges without retry or alternative solver.
Candidate pressure head, water content and diagnosed qbot are finite.
Independent complete-profile storage change minus (-qtop+qbot)*dt closes within 1e-10 cm water for every trial.
A1 and A2 pressure heads, water contents, qbot, integrated mass residual and solver diagnostics are bitwise identical.
B differs from A1 in qbot or candidate hydraulic state, proving the replay test is non-vacuous.
interpretation: PASS qualifies a research-only live below-profile H_phreatic-to-mode5 reduction and immutable-origin replay substrate.
PASS does not qualify inside-profile mode-1 active-domain truncation or saturated continuation.
PASS does not reclassify the current F-GC lower interface head as H_phreatic.
forbidden: no use of legacy-global mode-1 special constitutive branches
